items.summary: A healthcare titan is in a full sprint, but a recent stumble has investors asking if the best part of the race is already over.

items.title: Pfizer Stock Or Zoetis: Is The Comeback Worth Paying Up For?
items.summary: If you hold Pfizer (PFE) or Zoetis (ZTS), you hold the same idea: a branded medicine becomes a standard of care and keeps earning for years, in people or in animals. That is where it stops. Pfizer is buying replacements for older drugs losing exclusivity. Zoetis is cutting its effective price to keep the franchises it has. Same bet, two opposite defenses.

items.title: Eli Lilly Stock Has Become a Trillion-Dollar Giant. Is It Too Late to Buy?
items.summary: Eli Lilly just crossed the trillion-dollar threshold on the back of a GLP-1 empire growing at nearly 50% annually, but a recent pullback and rising risks are forcing investors to decide whether this pharmaceutical giant still has meaningful upside left.

items.title: GSK's Specialty Medicines Drive Growth Amid Looming HIV Patent Cliff
items.summary: GSK's Specialty Medicines are driving growth, but an approaching HIV patent cliff is pushing the company to accelerate its pipeline.

items.title: Why Has AbbVie Gone Quiet About Humira?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) has returned 23.3% over the past year, ahead of the S&P 500's (SPY) 18.5%, and the business behind that return has changed shape. Humira, the drug whose decline management once explained, took one sentence on the July 2026 earnings call. What that sentence no longer contains is the part a holder should look at.
